run_pybind11_includes: run python -m pybind11 --includes to print compiler include flags for pybind11 and Python headers
run_pybind11_help: run python -m pybind11 with no arguments to print the help message and available options
summarize_print_includes: summarize the print_includes function which collects and deduplicates include paths for pybind11 and Python
review_main_parser: review the main function argparse setup that handles the --includes flag for pybind11
run_pybind11_module: run the pybind11 module directly via python -m pybind11 to get help or include flags
